title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

**Gesundheitsberater / Gesundheits-Coach (Quereinstieg)**

Kunden/Interessenten Gewinnung Betreuung und Beratung

•    Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute mündliche Kenntnisse Schweizerdeutsch(weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus).

title: Technikos vadovas
description:
Ko tikimės iš Tavęs:
Atsakomybė už gamybą - įmonės mikroautobusų remonto organizavimą nuosavame autoservise ir kartu su komanda transporto paruošima keleivių pervežimo reisams vykdyti.

Pagrindinės funkcijos:
kartu su vairuotojais, servisų darbuotojais organizuoti  trumpalaikius ir ilgalaikius remonto darbus, visų transporto priemonių ir 35 vairuotojų darbo grafiko sudarymas. Esant reikalui pavaduoti serviso vadybininkus (meistrus priėmėjus).


Pagrindiniai reikalavimai:
remonto darbų išmanymas, gebėjimai organizuoti darbą, D kategorija, greitas darbas kompiuteriu, excel formulių sudarymas. Darbo užmokestis nuo 1500 Eur į rankas plius premija.

📩 CV siųskite personalas@atng.lt su tema „Technikos vadovas“
ir skambinkite mob. +37064362222, pasiteirauti, ar gautas CV.
Pokalbio metu tarsimės dėl susitikimo.

title: Ūkvedys
description:
Ieškome atsakingo, organizuoto ir praktiško žmogaus, kuris rūpintųsi pastato priežiūra, techniniais ir ūkiniais klausimais bei padėtų užtikrinti sklandžią kultūrinių veiklų aplinką.

ATSAKOMYBĖS:

• pastato ir teritorijos priežiūros organizavimas bei užtikrinimas;
• smulkių remonto ir ūkio darbų koordinavimas;
• techninės būklės stebėjimas, gedimų registravimas ir sprendimų organizavimas;
• bendravimas su tiekėjais, rangovais ir priežiūros paslaugų teikėjais;
• ūkinių priemonių, inventoriaus ir medžiagų apskaita bei užsakymas;
• pagalba renginių metu užtikrinant erdvių paruošimą ir tvarką;
• darbo saugos, tvarkos ir bendros objekto priežiūros užtikrinimas.

MES TIKIMĖS, KAD TU:

• esi atsakingas(-a), savarankiškas(-a) ir gebi greitai spręsti praktinius klausimus;
• turi panašaus darbo patirties (pastatų priežiūros ar ūkio administravimo srityje – privalumas);
• gebi planuoti darbus ir organizuoti procesus;
• turi gerus bendravimo įgūdžius ir moki dirbti komandoje;
• gebi dirbti lanksčiu grafiku, esant poreikiui – vakarais ar savaitgaliais;
• turi vairuotojo pažymėjimą.

SIŪLOME:

darbą pilnu etatu (40 val. per savaitę) ir lankstų darbo grafiką;
nuo 1800 Eur/mėn. atlyginimą su mokesčiais;
konkurencingą atlyginimą, priklausantį nuo patirties ir kompetencijų;
dinamišką ir draugišką darbo aplinką išskirtiniame kultūros ir paveldo objekte;
galimybę prisidėti prie kultūrinių veiklų įgyvendinimo bei prasmingų projektų;
profesionalią, palaikančią komandą ir galimybę augti kartu.
Jei susidomėjai, savo CV lauksime el. paštu info@vokesdvaras.lt iki 2026 m. rugsejo 15 d. Laiško temoje nurodyk „Ūkvedys (-ė)“. Susisieksime tik su atrinktais kandidatais.

title: Tralo vairuotojas
description:
Ieškomas naujas komandos narys darbo su techninės pagalbos kelyje automobiliu, turintis CE kategorijas.

Ko tikimės iš Tavęs:
Kai nėra automobilių ar kitos technikos pervežimo, vairuotojas serviso meistro nurodymu pristato dalis, veža senas dalis restauruoti, varo VIP klientų automobilius į techninę apžiūrą, testuoja prieš ir po remonto, retkarčiais veža keleivius su keleiviniu mikroautobusu. Reikalavimai - automobilių sandaros ir remonto procesų žinojimas.

Apmokame. Darbo užmokestis priklauso nuo atidirbtų valandų. Darbo laikas nuo 6.00 iki 16.00 val.



📩 CV siųskite personalas@atng.lt su tema „Tralo vairuotojas“ ir skambinkite nurodytu telefonu +37064362222, pasiteirauti, ar gavome CV.

Pokalbio metu tarsimės dėl susitikimo.

title: Suvirintojas
description:
Vykdyti turimos specialybės ir kvalifikacijos darbus bei darbus, kuriems atlikti užtenka jo turimos kvalifikacijos: 1. įvairių metalo gaminių gamyba ir remontas, atliekant tekinimo, frezavimo, šlifavimo, suvirinimo, sriegimo, pjovimo ir kitus šaltkalviškus detalių apdorojimo darbus; 2. įvairių katilinių bei šilumos tinklų įrengimų (siurblių, ventiliatorių, dūmsiurbių, ortakių), talpų, armatūros, garnitūros montavimas, demontavimas, remontas; 3. katilų, slėginių indų ir vamzdynų patalpose ir lauke, talpų montavimas, demontavimas, dažymas, izoliavimas bei kiti darbai iki pilno užbaigimo ir aplinkos sutvarkymo; 4. turint atitinkamą kvalifikaciją, nustatytos formos pažymėjimus, sertifikatus, metalo suvirinimo darbų vykdymas, metalo pjovimo, naudojant suskystintas dujas, darbų vykdymas, suvirinimo aparatų bei kitos suvirinimo darbams naudojamos įrangos priežiūra bei smulkaus remonto darbus; 5. miesto pastatų šildymo ir karšto vandens, vėdinimo sistemų bei šilumos punktų hidraulinių bandymų, praplovimų, šilumokaičių cheminių praplovimų, šilumos ir karšto vandens skaitiklių keitimo, vamzdynų ventilių, sklendžių, pačių vamzdynų remonto, keitimo, šiluminio izoliavimo, dažymo, žymėjimo ir kitų remonto darbų, šilumos tinklų remonto, paruošimo remonto darbams, užtikrinant patikimą ir ekonomišką jų darbą bei tinkamą techninį būvį, vykdymas; 6. žemės darbų iškasose, gilesnėse kaip l,5 m šuliniuose ir kituose statiniuose, uždarose talpyklose;
7. krovinių tvarkymo, krovimo rankomis bei smulkaus remonto darbų, kėlimo reikmenų priežiūros darbų, stropavimo darbų atlikimas; 8. Bendrovės įrengimų, miesto šildomų objektų šildymo ir karšto vandens sistemų gedimų, technologinių sutrikimų, sutrikimų, avarijų, gaisrų gesinimo, aplinkos užteršimo šalinimo darbų atlikimas.

description:
- savarankiškai pasirinkti darbo metodus ir spręsti iškylančias problemas;
- elektros ir automatikos sistemų supratimas, gebėjimas skaityti ir analizuoti schemas;
- PLC (programuojamų loginių valdiklių ) žinios, jų programavimas;
- pavarų, jutiklių, valdymo įrangos konfigūravimas, derinimas;
-  vykdyti elektros energijos tiekimo sistemų priežiūrą ir remontą, nustatyti ir šalinti įrangos trikdžius:
- vykdyti apšvietimo elektrinių tinklų, šviestuvų, armatūros montavimą (jungiklių, rozečių ir kt.) ir remontą;
- vykdyti elektros įrangos elektrotechninių parametrų matavimus (izoliacijos varžos tikrinimo, pereinamosios varžos, įžeminimo kontūrų varžos būklės nustatymas);
- vykdyti matavimo prietaisų komplektų tikrinimo, profilaktikos, programavimo, derinimo, remonto, gedimų šalinimo darbus;
- vykdyti automatinio reguliavimo sistemų veikimo tikrinimo, profilaktikos, derinimo, gedimų šalinimo darbus;
- šiluminės automatikos, impulsinių linijų profilaktikos, remonto, gedimų šalinimo darbus;
- gebėti skaityti techninę literatūrą anglų kalba.
- vykdyti kitas funkcijas, kurios numatytos darbo sutartyje, Lietuvos Respublikos teisės ir Bendrovės lokaliniuose norminiuose aktuose.

Bendrovės įrengimų, miesto šildomų objektų šildymo ir karšto vandens sistemų gedimų, technologinių sutrikimų, sutrikimų, avarijų, gaisrų gesinimo, aplinkos užteršimo šalinimo darbų atlikimas.

title: Priežiūros technikas
description:
Katilinės įrenginių priežiūra ir valdymas- katilinių įrenginių paleidimas, stabdymas, reguliavimas, degimo proceso kontrolė ir reguliavimas, smulkių einamųjų remonto bei einamųjų eksploatacijos darbų vykdymas, užtikrinant normalų įrenginių darbą pagal užduotus technologinius parametrus bei reikiamą jų techninį būvį;
- perjungimų, dalyvaujant vyresniajam priežiūros technikui, vykdymas;
- dujų reguliavimo punktų (DRP), cheminio ūkio, priežiūra, reguliavimas, smulkių remonto bei einamųjų eksploatacijos darbų vykdymas;
- tvarkos, švaros katilinių patalpose bei teritorijose palaikymo darbų vykdymas;
- įrenginių technologinių sutrikimų, sutrikimų, avarijų, gaisrų gesinimo, aplinkos užteršimo atvejų likvidavimo darbų vykdymas;
- krovinių perkėlimo, krovimo, nešimo rankomis darbai;
- chemiškai valyto vandens kokybės kontrolė, cheminio vandens valymo įrenginių darbo palaikymo bei vandens kokybės užtikrinimo darbų vykdymas;
- reikalingų materialinių vertybių, transportavimo, pakrovimo, iškrovimo, sandėliavimo darbų vykdymas;
- katilinės įrenginių ir vamzdynų izoliavimo, dažymo darbų vykdymas;
- kitų nenuolatinio pobūdžio pavedimų ir kitų pareigų, kurios numatytos darbo sutartyje, Lietuvos Respublikos teisės ir Bendrovės vidiniuose norminiuose aktuose, vykdymas.

title: Darbininkas
description:
1.   Atlieka smulkius gimnazijos pastatų, patalpų, įrenginių, baldų ir kito inventoriaus remonto darbus.
2.    Atlieka vidaus ir lauko aplinkos tvarkymo, priežiūros bei gerinimo darbus.
3.    Padeda pernešti, pakrauti, iškrauti ir sustatyti baldus, mokymo priemones, inventorių bei kitus krovinius.
4.    Montuoja, demontuoja ir perstato baldus, lentynas, stendus bei kitą įrangą pagal poreikį.
5.    Atlieka dažymo, glaistymo, sandarinimo ir kitus paprastus apdailos darbus, kuriems nereikalinga speciali kvalifikacija.
6.    Prižiūri ir remontuoja tvoras, vartelius, suoliukus, šiukšliadėžes, sporto aikštelių įrangą bei kitus lauko infrastruktūros elementus.
7.    Padeda paruošti patalpas renginiams, egzaminams, susirinkimams ir kitai gimnazijos veiklai.
8.    Prižiūri darbo įrankius, užtikrina jų tinkamą naudojimą ir saugojimą.
9.    Pastebėjęs pastatų, įrenginių ar inžinerinių sistemų gedimus, nedelsdamas informuoja direktoriaus pavaduotoją ūkiui arba kitą atsakingą asmenį.
10.    Dalyvauja sezoniniuose teritorijos priežiūros darbuose ir prisideda prie estetinės gimnazijos aplinkos palaikymo.
11.    Laikosi darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos, priešgaisrinės saugos, civilinės saugos, higienos bei vidaus darbo tvarkos reikalavimų.
12.    Pagal kompetenciją padeda vykdyti pasirengimo ekstremaliosioms situacijoms, mobilizacijai ir civilinės saugos priemones, padeda įrengti ar parengti numatytas patalpas, perkelti reikalingą inventorių ir priemones.
13.    Racionaliai naudoja darbo priemones ir medžiagas, saugo gimnazijos turtą.
14.    Vykdo kitus vienkartinio pobūdžio darbus ir teisėtus gimnazijos direktoriaus ar direktoriaus pavaduotojo ūkiui pavedimus, susijusius su pareigybės funkcijomis.

However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), the University's main library, supports students, researchers, staff and the wider public by providing documentary collections, information services and expertise that contribute to learning, teaching, and research.

Your role
The role will focus on ensuring continuity of services, maintaining collection quality and supporting ongoing academic needs.
• Act as a key contact / interface between the libraries and University stakeholders, including faculty, researchers, students and administrative departments, in particular within the Faculty of Law, Economics & Finance (FDEF)
• Take ownership of collection plans and budgets for the relevant subject areas,  ensuring expertise and added value to faculty
• Contribute actively to the preparation, update and implementation of collection development strategies, acquisition plans and related documentation, and contribute to defining and adapting practices, tools and approaches based on needs
• Provide expert advice, research support and information literacy training tailored to the needs of students, researchers and teaching staff, and act as a sparring partner for academic users
• Reply to enquiries and support users in identifying, accessing and using relevant documentary resources, databases and information tools, providing added value guidance and expert advice where needed
• Create and maintain subject guides, web pages, bibliographies, thematic selections, tutorials and other user support material, aligned with the specific needs and priorities of FDEF and related disciplines
• Monitor trends in teaching, learning and research in the relevant disciplines in order to keep collections and services up to date, analyse needs and propose improvements and adapted approaches
• Maintain regular interaction with academic stakeholders to identify evolving curriculum needs, new programmes, research priorities and resource requirements, and translate these into concrete collection and service developments
• Promote the libraries' collections, resources and services through targeted communication, outreach, training and advocacy activities that emphasise added value to faculty and researchers
• Analyse usage data and user feedback to support evidence based decisions, prioritise activities based on needs and timeframe, and drive continuous improvement of collections and services
• Contribute to shaping and improving practices for cataloguing, classification, signage, collection maintenance and the organisation of documentary resources according to applicable standards

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent by work experience in Library, Information or Documentation Science; or a Master's degree in a relevant discipline complemented by training or experience in information management
• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in an academic or research library
• Strong experience in collection development, user support, reference services, information literacy and communication with academic users
• Good knowledge of library management systems, discovery tools, catalogues, databases and digital information resources
• Experience with collection development policies, acquisition workflows, budget monitoring, usage analysis and service improvement
• Ability to define, apply and improve standards, procedures, methods and tools related to library services and collection management
• Advanced digital literacy and good command of MS Office and professional library tools. Knowledge of Alma would be an advantage

Language Requirements: Excellent command of English and French (C1); very good command of German and/or Luxembourgish (B2) would be considered an asset.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

title: OpEx Leader - Luxembourg Site (m/f)
description:
Description:

Job Description

At DuPont, we are redefining what operational excellence looks like in advanced manufacturing. We are seeking an experienced Operational Excellence (OpEx)
Leader to help accelerate the performance, digital transformation, and long-term competitiveness of our Luxembourg Site, supporting world-class businesses including Tyvek®, Typar®, Power & Utilities, and Shared Services.
This is a highly visible leadership role where you will partner with site leaders, engineers, operators, and functional teams to turn strategy into execution, build continuous improvement capability, and deliver measurable business results. You will champion the DuPont Business System, coach teams in structured problem solving, and drive a culture where performance is transparent, problems are solved at the source, and improvement is part of everyday work.
If you are passionate about Lean transformation, digital innovation, operational performance, and developing people, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact at one of DuPont's key manufacturing sites.

What You'll Do

Lead the Operational Excellence Journey

• Drive the deployment and sustainability of DuPont's OpEx Management System across the Luxembourg Site.
• Coach leaders and teams on Daily Visual Management, Operating Reviews, tiered accountability, performance management, and continuous improvement best practices.
• Establish meaningful SQDIP performance metrics that enable teams to identify gaps quickly and focus on what matters most.
• Shape and manage the site's OpEx roadmap, ensuring improvement efforts are aligned with business priorities and strategic objectives.
• Develop OpEx capabilities through coaching, mentoring, practical training, and hands-on leadership.

Champion Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Lead structured problem-solving initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, A3 Thinking, PDCA, 5 Whys, Pareto analysis, and root-cause methodologies.
• Facilitate Kaizen events and improvement workshops that deliver sustainable operational results.
• Help drive key site priorities, including productivity, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, quality performance, waste reduction, yield improvement, and cost competitiveness.

title: Cost Management Team Leader (m/f)
description:
Cost Management Team Leader (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1125


Back to Search

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

• Lead the Bank's cost management framework, ensuring effective financial steering of operating expenses, investment spending, and strategic initiatives across all business units.
• Act as a trusted Finance partner to Senior Management and business leaders by providing insightful analysis, challenging spending decisions, identifying optimization opportunities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's strategic objectives.
• Support Executive Management, the CFO and senior governance bodies in evaluating strategic projects, transformation initiatives, investments and acquisitions through robust financial analysis and business case assessments.
• Develop a strong cost-conscious culture across the organization while ensuring resources are allocated efficiently to support growth, regulatory requirements, operational resilience and strategic ambitions.
• Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for cost controlling, planning, analysis and management reporting.
• Own and continuously enhance the Bank's cost management framework, policies and governance.
• Lead the budget and forecasting processes for operating expenses and investment spending.
• Monitor cost performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying risks, opportunities and corrective actions.
• Lead the evolution of the Bank's cost allocation framework, ensuring transparent, accurate and business-relevant allocation of costs across customers, products, channels and business units to support profitability analysis, pricing decisions and strategic resource allocation.
• Act as primary Finance partner for senior executives, department heads and business leaders regarding cost management matters.
• Organize and lead periodic cost review meetings with ExCo members and senior management.
• Challenge business assumptions, investment requests and resource allocation decisions through a constructive and data-driven approach.
• Build strong relationships across Finance, COO, Risk, HR, CEO Office and Business Lines to ensure alignment on financial priorities.
• Support Management in evaluating strategic projects and transformation initiatives.
• Perform financial assessments of acquisitions, partnerships and strategic opportunities.
• Evaluate expected benefits, costs, risks and return on investment of major initiatives.
• Deliver timely, accurate and insightful management reporting on costs and investment performance.
• Conduct ad-hoc financial analyses and simulations on business initiatives, cost drivers and strategic options.
• Drive improvements in planning methodologies, management reporting and analytical capabilities.
• Promote automation and digitalization of cost management processes.
• Contribute to the evolution of Finance tools, data governance and performance management frameworks.
• Lead, coach and develop the Cost Management team.
• Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.
• Ensure appropriate succession planning, talent development and capability building within the team.

Your skills:

• Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related field. CFA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent qualifications considered an advantage.
• Minimum 12-15 years of experience in FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Cost Management, Corporate Finance, Strategy or related fields within financial services.
• Minimum 5 years in leadership positions managing teams and engaging directly with executive management.
• Fluency in French and English. Luxembourgish and/or German considered an asset.
• Strong understanding of banking products, business models, profitability drivers, financial planning processes and performance management. Knowledge of banking regulatory environment and capital considerations is an advantage.
• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills. Strong knowledge of financial planning, reporting and data visualization tools. Experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) systems, Power BI, Microstrategy, or similar tools is a plus.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Ability to engage and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
• Strategic mindset combined with strong analytical capabilities.
• Excellent presentation skills and ability to translate complex financial information into actionable recommendations.
• Strong leadership and change management capabilities.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

Fund Controller

Position Summary

The Fund Controller is responsible for the overall financial governance, oversight, and representation of a portfolio of Real Estate / Private Equity funds serviced.

Acting as the primary finance lead and trusted advisor to the client, the Fund Controller provides fund-level accountability for financial reporting, investor deliverables, audit coordination, regulatory compliance, and operational performance. The role serves as the key interface between the client and EY's delivery teams, ensuring that all outputs produced through EY's Managed Services platform are accurate, complete, timely and fit for investor, auditor and regulatory use.

The Fund Controller operates within a global delivery model leveraging EY's technology-enabled platform, including fund accounting, treasury, consolidation, reporting and workflow solutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Fund Governance and Fund Representation

• Serve as the designated Fund Controller for a portfolio of client funds.
• Provide overall governance and financial oversight across all fund processes.
• Review, challenge and approve financial outputs prepared by EY delivery teams.
• Assess whether reporting outputs are fit for investor, auditor, lender and regulatory purposes.
• Act as the final approval authority for fund-level reporting deliverables.
• Escalate significant risks, accounting issues and operational matters to client leadership and EY management.

2. Client Relationship Management

• Act as the primary finance contact for assigned clients.

• Build trusted relationships with CFOs, Fund Directors, Portfolio Managers and Investors.

title: EXPERIENCED RESEARCHER IN THE FIELD OF FRUGAL/GREEN AI (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.
• Developing and coaching the LIST RDI teams in this topic; and
• Maximising the impact of Frugal AI initiatives through externally funded projects with public or private organisations.
Your role will include:
• Lead the research, development and innovation (RDI) activities on the Frugal AI topic, defining and shaping research directions in line with LIST's strategic objectives.
• Drive the development of innovative Frugal AI technologies and methodologies.
• Develop and manage RDI project proposals, ensuring alignment with strategic research objectives at the group and unit level. Identify funding and grant opportunities; prepare and submit proposals to secure financial support for RDI activities.
• Oversee the execution of RDI projects with external partners, ensuring that they meet their objectives, timelines and budgets.
•  Align with ongoing standards around Frugal AI and Green AI and explore opportunities and collaborations with the consortia behind those standards.
• Establish and maintain collaborations with industrial partners, public organisations, research institutes and universities to enhance research impact and technology transfer.
• Actively participate in EU and (inter)national consortia and contribute to collaborative research projects.
• Increase LIST's visibility in the AI field through publications, presentations and participation in relevant forums and conferences.

Deep scientific and technical expertise, demonstrated by publications and successful RDI projects, in at least some of these topics is required:
• Frugal AI / Green AI and, in general, the design and deployment of AI models in low-resource environments.
• Generative AI, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning and optimisation techniques for LLMs.
• Use of AI to improve sustainability aspects of AI and non-AI systems based on an analysis of their current architecture and operational data.
• Machine learning and neural network architectures, including convolutional, recurrent and transformer networks.
• MLOps and model management to streamline ML development.
• Multimodal input and how multimodality impacts frugality.
• Data management, data valorisation and data processing techniques, including data sandboxes, data spaces, data synthesis and data augmentation.
• AI evaluation, assessment, testing and benchmarking, including AI sandbox.
• Knowledge of the latest trends and developments in AI, with the ability to apply these advances to practical, real-world challenges.
• Experience working with business domain experts to apply the above AI innovation capabilities in at least one vertical domain in the private and/or public sector, such as finance, space, cybersecurity, energy, mobility and logistics, defence, manufacturing, education, health, central or local government, etc.
• Sustainable practices and global initiatives in the area (UNESCO sustainable development goals, digital product passport initiatives, product circularity data sheets…) that may have influence in the evolution and growing interest in Frugal AI.
• Software engineering and, in particular, low-code technologies. This includes some knowledge of low-code and no-code AI approaches.

In addition, we would appreciate proven experience in the following soft skills:
• Passion for AI research and technology with a relentless drive for innovation.
• Proven experience in leading and managing RDI projects in AI/ML with a track record of successful project delivery and innovation.
• Experience of building and maintaining collaborative networks with academic, industrial and research partners, with excellent networking skills.
• Proven ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-expert audiences.
• Experience in organising workshops, seminars and conferences to disseminate research findings and promote community engagement.
• Ability to identify emerging research areas and technology trends and set the direction for future research efforts and technological advances.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Language skills

Your LIST benefits

About the Role

This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for designing, building and leading Uplift360's operational backbone.
As Operations Director, you will oversee the company's operational infrastructure, business services, corporate operations, governance and support functions across Luxembourg and the United Kingdom, ensuring the organisation operates efficiently, compliantly and at scale.
Working directly with the Co-Founders, CTO and Senior Leadership Team, you will establish the operational systems, governance frameworks and management disciplines required to support accelerated growth, investor readiness, customer delivery and industrial expansion.
A key objective of the role is to help Uplift360 scale intelligently through the adoption of automation, AI-enabled workflows and modern digital operating systems. You will be expected to identify opportunities to increase organisational productivity, strengthen decision-making and reduce operational overhead through the effective application of technology.
Success in the role will be measured not only by organisational growth, but by your ability to build a scalable operating model that combines exceptional people, robust processes and intelligent technology - enabling growth without a proportional increase in administrative complexity or headcount.
The role has management responsibility for the HR function and broader business services team. However, this is not an HR leadership position. The Operations Director will ensure that the HR function is appropriately resourced, managed and aligned to business priorities, but will not personally deliver HR services or own the company's people strategy.
Responsibility for HR strategy, workforce planning, organisational design, reward strategy and board-level people governance remains with the founders and designated HR leadership.
This role combines strategic leadership with operational execution and is ideally suited to an experienced operational leader who has successfully scaled organisations in high-growth, venture-backed or industrial environments.

About Uplift360

Uplift360 is an Advanced Materials Company securing sovereign supply for Europe's defence, security and vital industries.
We secure and produce critical advanced materials, including carbon fibre and aramids, for European defence and industry by sourcing, recovering and regenerating high-value materials into secure industrial supply chains.
As geopolitical instability, supply chain fragility and industrial competition intensify, access to advanced materials is becoming a defining strategic advantage. Uplift360 is building the infrastructure and technology required to secure it.

• Lead company-wide projects that improve organisational capability and effectiveness.
• Coordinate strategic planning activities, leadership initiatives and cross-functional execution priorities.

• Drive execution of business priorities through structured programme management, action tracking and escalation discipline.

• 10+ years' experience in Operations Leadership, Business Operations, General Management, Chief of Staff or related leadership roles.
• Experience within high-growth, venture-backed, technology, manufacturing, industrial or deep-tech environments.
• Proven track record of building scalable operational frameworks and business systems.
• Experience leading cross-functional business services and operational support functions.
• Practical experience implementing automation, AI-enabled workflows, digital collaboration tools, dashboards or process improvements that materially improve organisational productivity.

Why Join Uplift360?

We are a family friendly company that believes in the importance of supporting our employees to find and maintain an excellent work life balance. Your physical, mental and financial wellbeing matters to us.

title: Electro-Mechanical Engineer (M/F/X)
description:
Description de tâches:
About HITEC Founded in 1986, HITEC is a 100%-owned Luxembourg engineering and technology company with around 60 employees, designing and building high-technology solutions across satellite ground segment, mission-critical communications, industrial testing and measuring equipment, and intelligent traffic management systems. With a multi-disciplinary, client-centric approach, we serve private, institutional and public-sector clients nationally and internationally, in more than 30 countries.The successful candidate will work on the following product lines: satellite ground segment equipment, industrial testing instruments and mission-critical systems, across the full development cycle from concept, design and dimensioning to commissioning, testing and validation.
Your Activities
· Dimension and select motion related components such as motors, drive systems, controllers, motion safety components
· Design, dimension, implement, test and maintain electro-mechanical and motion-control solutions, including PLC code, for internal products and external customers
· Provide design and analysis services supporting product development across HITEC's business units, in close collaboration with mechanical engineering
· Actively support the testing process by maintaining and driving functional tests, using existing or new test plans
· Define, document, implement and test new features and technologies in existing or new products
· Start-up in-house designed machinery and commercial components
· Contribute to technical documentation and to the team's technology survey activities
· Occasional travel abroad (approximately 10 to 20%) for supplier and customer site visits, installations or commissioning may be required
· Interact with internal and external customers, partners and suppliers to support, integrate and promote HITEC's electrical and automated solutions
· Help develop and put in place best practices in product design and verification
· Pro-actively introduce, document and disseminate new technologies and concepts as part of the team's technology survey activities
· Collaborate across electrical, mechanical and software engineering within our small and cross-functional team Your Profile
· Engineer, Master's degree in electrical or automation engineering
· Control theory background and knowledge of PLC programming languages (PLCopen Structured Text)
· Knowlege of PC-based programming languages (Java, C++, C or Python) is considered a plus
· At least 5 years of relevant experience, including electro-mechanical devices such as electrical motors and power electronics
· A good understanding of safety risks related to electro-mechanical machinery and the related electrical safety concepts to address them
· Comfortable working in an English-speaking environment, including technical discussions and documentation; French, German or Luxembourgish considered a plus
· Ability to adapt to new situations and work with a variety of stakeholders and partners Why Join HITEC? A small, cross-functional teamThe engineering teams being relatively compact means that you will work across the full lifecycle of a product rather than one narrow task, that you are exposed to adjacent disciplines (electrical, mechanical, software), and people who join the team typically take on broader or more senior responsibilities faster than in larger organisations.
4 main fields of activity
HITEC Luxembourg develops, produces and maintains Satellite Ground Segment solutions for space and satellite applications used in commercial, defence and scientific projects. Over the past 25 years, we have provided numerous projects within Europe, from the tropics to the polar regions, ensuring secured and reliable operations for our customers.
The company develops and produces industrial Testing Instruments used in R&D and in quality control to measure physical properties of rubber fillers and battery materials. Being a reference on the market, our instruments are used worldwide by all major producers and users of these materials to ensure compliance with ASTM standards.
The Mission Critical offering enables organizations to communicate, collaborate and maintain real-time situational awareness when it matters most. From emergency response and defense operations to critical infrastructure and public safety, our solutions provide secure and resilient connectivity, enabling teams to access, share and act on critical information wherever they operate, even in the most challenging environments.
The Traffic Management department provides engineering and maintenance services for intelligent transportation systems. We design and implement cutting-edge smart mobility solutions that improve road safety, optimize traffic flow, and support sustainable transportation strategies for connected and autonomous mobility, while ensuring the reliability and performance of road infrastructure.
Decisions made in LuxembourgHITEC is independently owned and managed. Decisions about products, projects and people are made locally, by the people you work with on a daily basis.
Equipment deployed worldwideGround segment equipment designed by this team is installed on operational sites worldwide. Testing instruments are also sold worldwide and used daily by manufacturers in quality control and R&D.
An established, certified employerHITEC is ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certified, holds the ESR (“Entreprise Socialement Responsable”) label from INDR, is a signatory of the IMS Diversity Charter, and has signed Luxembourg's National Pact “Business and Human Rights.”
Working in LuxembourgLuxembourg is a small, safe and multilingual country (English, French, German and Luxembourgish are all in common use at work), with one of the most international populations in Europe (over 170 nationalities live and work here). It offers a high standard of living, free public transport nationwide, good schools including international and European schools, accessible healthcare, and short distances overall: city, countryside and neighbouring countries are all close by. Its central European location also means easy access to most major European cities for travel (more information on https://workinluxembourg.com)For candidates from countries without a specific agreement with Luxembourg, the standard work permit process can also be relatively fast.
What we offer
· Work on satellite, mission-critical and industrial testing technologies used in more than 30 countries
· Involvement across the full product lifecycle, from concept to validation, with real project experience
· The opportunity to develop your skills in adjacent engineering fields
· A stimulating and entrepreneurial work environment
· A small, cross-functional engineering team with room to grow into broader responsibilities
· An independently-owned and managed Luxembourg company with local decision-making
· A competitive compensation package aligned with the Luxembourg / Grande Région engineering market We are looking for people, not perfect applications. Please tell us, in your own words, what you would bring to HITEC and why this role interests you.

description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Ministère d'État - Service des médias, de la connectivité et de la politique numérique (SMC), unité Connectivités Radio critiques Missions Le Process Manager a pour mission de définir, implémenter, piloter et améliorer en continu les processus de gestion des services IT selon les bonnes pratiques ITIL, au sein d'une unité agissant comme autorité contractant/ante d'un réseau de communications radios critiques opéré par des prestataires externes. Il/elle garantit la mise en place effective de processus, leur appropriation et leur suivi opérationnel. Mise en place et gouvernance des processus:  Formaliser; Cartographier et documenter les processus opérationnels et organisationnels conformément aux exigences réglementaires et internes;  Coordonner les contributions des parties prenant/antes pour assurer la cohérence des processus transversaux et interconnectés;  Proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions d'optimisation, d'harmonisation et documenter des processus ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, etc.) aux réseaux critiques tout en garantissant la cohérence avec les prestataires;  Identifier les besoins d'amélioration, les interférences et les risques opérationnels;  Assurer le suivi et la mise à jour des procédures, modes opératoires et référentiels internes. Suivi et pilotage opérationnel: Superviser l'application des processus;  Contribuer aux réunions relatives au programme;  Mettre en place et vérifier les KPI et tableaux de bord; Rédiger des résumés de conformité des processus opérationnels et signaler les écarts au responsable de programme. Amélioration continue:  Proposer des optimisations;  Piloter les plans d'actions;  Mettre en œuvre un management CSI. Coordination avec les prestataires: Documenter et vérifier les interactions entre administrations et prestataires; Définir et documenter les séances d'examen des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) avec les prestataires;  Assurer la documentation et la traçabilité de toutes les réunions définies dans le processus. Applications bureautiques:  Savoir travailler avec Excel,; Word et Powerpoint;  PM tools. Maîtrise obligatoire des 3 langues administratives (LU, FR, DE) et l'Anglais. title: Ergothérapeute (H/F)
description: CDI à temps partiel (%) Le Centre Hospitalier Neuro-Psychiatrique (CHNP) est un établissement public de référence au Luxembourg, structuré autour de trois entités aux missions complémentaires :La Rehaklinik, dédiée aux activités cliniques de réhabilitation psychiatrique ;Le Pontalize, spécialisé dans la prise en charge des personnes âgées ;De Park, axé sur l'accompagnement socio-pédagogique de personnes présentant un invalidité mental. Engagé dans une démarche de qualité et d'amélioration continue, le CHNP s'appuie sur l'expertise et l'engagement de plus de  collaborateurs et collaboratrices, ainsi que sur une administration transversale structurée soutenant l'ensemble de ses missions cliniques, médico-sociales et organisationnelles. L'hôpital s'engage à soutenir ses collaborateurs afin de garantir, à chaque moment et en tout lieu, la meilleure prise en charge possible pour chaque patient ou résident. Le CHNP veille également à favoriser un environnement de travail respectueux, fondé sur la confiance et une communication ouverte, propice au bien-être de ses collaborateurs. La Rehaklinik dispose de  lits hospitaliers. Afin de répondre à sa mission, elle s'appuie sur six domaines de compétences complémentaires :Addictologie ;Troubles anxieux et de l'humeur ;Troubles psychotiques ;Psychiatrie juvénile ;Psychiatrie socio-judiciaire ;Géronto-psychiatrie. Ces expertises sont complétées par une offre de soins diversifiée, incluant notamment un dispositif ambulatoire développé, permettant d'assurer des parcours de soins adaptés, continus et centrés sur les besoins des patients. Conçu comme un centre d'information, de consultation et de prise en charge ambulatoire, le Centre Äddi-C est spécialisé dans l'addiction, particulier/ièrement l'alcoolo-dépendance. L'offre thérapeutique est individualisée selon les besoins spécifiques de chaque personne. Des entretiens d'information anonymes sont également proposés à ceux qui se posent des questions quant à leur consommation d'alcool... Vous garantirez un rôle de coordination pour tous les collaborateurs affectés dans le service (l'équipe multidisciplinaire est composée d'une dizaine de personnes, médecins psychiatres, psychologues, psychothérapeutes, ergothérapeutes, psychomotriciens, infirmiers et infirmiers psychiatriques). Le poste sera basé en ville. Vos tâches consisteront entre autres à :Créer une relation thérapeutique avec les patients ;Evaluer et mettre en place des traitements personnalisés et appropriés au projet de vie du résident (Constats / évaluations / diagnostics ergothérapeutiques) ;Planifier les thérapies en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe multidisciplinaire ;Aider les patients à se structurer (gestion du temps, organisation, rangement, compétences sociales et de communication, gestion du stress, hygiène de vie, .) ;Développer des démarches thérapeutiques personnalisées pour aider les patients à retrouver leur indépendance et leur qualité de vie ;Proposer des prises en charge en individuel et en groupe ;Participer régulier/ièrement aux réunions de service ;Assurer le lien avec les différentes parties prenant/antes. Profil : Vous possédez un diplôme d'ergothérapeute et êtes détenteur de l'autorisation d'exercer au Grand-Duché de Luxembourg ;Vous possédez une expérience réussie dans le domaine de la  mentale ;Vous maîtrisez idéalement deux des trois langues officielles du pays, toute autre langue constituera un atout ; Vous travaillez de façon organisée et autonome tout en étant capable de collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe. Ce que nous offrons : Un emploi motivant dans un environnement respectueux, dynamique et stimulant ;Poste conventionné CCT-FHL ; heures hebdomadaire (équivalent temps plein) ;Rémunération sur  mois ;Formation continue ;Pécule de vacances ; jours de congés (équivalent temps plein), congé social, .Salle de sport, restauration à tarifs avantageux, . ;Possibilités de stationnement sur site et à proximité. Traitement de vos données personnelles : Nous vous informons que le traitement de vos données personnelles communiquées dans le cadre du processus de sélection et de recrutement s'effectue conformément à la Notice d'Information sur le traitement des données à caractère personnel dans le cadre du recrutement. Cette notice peut être consultée sur notre site web www.chnp.lu. Nous vous remercions de bien vouloir en prendre connaissance avant l'envoi de votre candidature.Les candidatures devront être composées d'une lettre de motivation et d'un curriculum vitae complet.Vous reconnaissez-vous dans cette annonce ? N'hésitez pas à postuler !

title: Infirmier(ère) ou Infirmier(ère) Psychiatrique - Projet FACT (H/F)
description: CDI à temps plein ZithaUnit a.s.b.l. et la Rehaklinik du CHNP unissent leurs forces pour améliorer les soins psychiatriques ambulatoires grâce à l'implémentation du modèle FACT (Flexible Assertive Community Treatment).Pour ce projet, financé par le Ministère de la  et de la Sécurité sociale, nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés pour faire partie de cette initiative innovant/ante.Le modèle FACT, basé sur des preuves scientifiques, combine flexibilité, assertivité et soins communautaires pour offrir un soutien holistique et individualisé.Si vous souhaitez contribuer à des soins de  mentale novateurs, rejoignez notre équipe dynamique et engagée. Ensemble, bâtissons un avenir meilleur pour la  mentale au Luxembourg !Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire, votre mission consistera à aider les patients dans leur rétablissement et leur bien-être personnel. Par le biais du traitement de réadaptation, vous les aiderez à améliorer leur  et à retrouver une vie aussi autonome et satisfaisant/ante que possible. Vous aiderez les patients à reprendre le contrôle de leur vie et à trouver leur place dans la société par des mesures es, sociales, professionnelles, éducatives et techniques. Le suivi a lieu dans le milieu de vie du patient et vous travaillerez en réseau. Les bureaux du service seront localisés dans la commune d'Ettelbrück. Les suivis concerneront des personnes principalement situées dans le nord du Luxembourg. Le suivi a lieu dans le milieu de vie du patient et vous travaillez en réseau. Vos tâches consisteront entre autres à : Participer quotidien/iennement au suivi des patients en situation aigue, en collaboration avec les autres membres de l'équipe ;Gérer de façon autonome la planification et la tenue des suivis individuels dont vous êtes référent ;Créer une relation de confiance et une alliance thérapeutique avec les patients ;Accompagner le patient dans ses activités quotidien/iennes ;Favoriser la mise en place d'un cadre sécurisant pour les patients ;Prévenir les crises et intervenir efficacement en cas de situation d'urgence ;Mener des entretiens thérapeutiques visant la gestion de la  et de ses symptômes ;Encadrer la préparation et l'administration des traitements médicamenteux ;Lorsque cela est possible, intégrer et soutenir les familles et les proches ;Garantir une excellente collaboration avec les intervenants externes concernés ;Assurer une documentation rigoureur/euse dans les dossiers patients ;Participer activement aux réunions d'équipe et aux formations ;Contribuer à l'innovation et à l'amélioration de la qualité des prestations. Profil : Vous possédez un diplôme d'infirmier ou d'infirmier psychiatrique et êtes détenteur de l'autorisation d'exercer au Grand-Duché de Luxembourg ;Vous possédez idéalement une expérience réussie dans le domaine de la  mentale ;Vous maîtrisez deux des trois langues officielles du pays ;Vous travaillez de façon organisée et autonome tout en étant capable de collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe ;Vous possédez obligatoirement le permis B. Traitement de vos données personnelles : Nous vous informons que le traitement de vos données personnelles communiquées dans le cadre du processus de sélection et de recrutement s'effectue conformément à la Notice d'Information sur le traitement des données à caractère personnel dans le cadre du recrutement.
