title: HR Site Lead, LER
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?  

At HemoCue, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

HemoCue is a leading provider of point-of-care diagnostic solutions, enabling healthcare practitioners across clinical settings and geographies to improve patient outcomes and clinical workflows. For more than four decades we’ve been advancing what’s possible at the point of care. HemoCue offers point-of-care testing for hemoglobin, glucose and HbA1c as well as total and differential white blood cell count.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The HR Site Lead, LER, is responsible for driving labor and employee relations at the HemoCue headquarters site in Ängelholm, ensuring a compliant, constructive, and high-performing work environment. This role is central in managing union relations, advising leaders on employment matters, and safeguarding adherence to Swedish labor law and internal policies.

You will act as HR partner to leaders balancing business needs with legal and contractual obligations. As part of a global HR organization, you will collaborate closely with HR colleagues to ensure consistent, high-quality HR delivery while supporting a strong “one HR” approach in a matrix environment.

As HR Site Lead, LER, you will proactively drive initiatives that strengthen employee relations and contribute to sustainable organizational performance.

This role is based onsite in Ängelholm and reports to the Senior Director, Labor and Employee Relations, at Radiometer with a dotted line to Senior Director, HR at HemoCue.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

    Act as a trusted advisor to managers on employee relations cases.
    Lead and manage labor relations, including union negotiations, consultations, and relationship management with both white- and blue-collar unions.
    Maintain high standards of HR data accuracy and reporting, ensuring compliance with our QMS and audit readiness.
    Provide compliance and reporting activities.
    Conduct onboarding and offboarding activities.
    Managing hosted associates.
    Manage and drive HR projects that align with business objectives.

The essential requirements of the job include:

    Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or equivalent discipline.
    Proficiency in Swedish and English, written and verbally.
    5+ years of HR experience with a strong focus on labor and employee relations
    Strong knowledge of Swedish employment law and collective bargaining frameworks
    Proven experience in leading union negotiations and managing relationships with multiple unions
    Excellent IT skills (Office Package, HR Systems, AI)

Application

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to submit yours as soon as possible.

Please note that response time may be longer due to the summer holiday period.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Research Engineer (fixed-term)
description:
Research Engineer (fixed-term)

We are now looking for a Research Engineer to join our Wood & Pulp Technology Team in the Group Innovation and R&D function. This is a fixed-term parental leave substitution from 1 September 2026 until 30 September 2027.

The location for the role is flexible. Ideally you are based in Sweden or Finland, however other European locations would be possible. The role reports to the Head of Wood & Pulp Technology.  

Be part of a nature positive future

The purpose of the role is to support wood innovation activities in Stora Enso. And to provide customers and colleagues with expert technical knowledge on the application and performance of CLT and LVL.  

Your main responsibilities include

    Providing engineering and wood processing expertise to help develop ideas, accelerate innovation projects, and solve problems  
    Supporting customers and sales by providing technical customer support in the use of CLT and LVL for construction
    Participating in project teams to deliver innovation projects to expected timescales, budgets, and desired deliverables
    Managing mass timber research activities
    Supporting colleagues on certification and building regulation requirements for mass timber products

About you

We are looking for a skilled professional who has the ambition for continuous improvement. You aim to be the best at what you do, share your knowledge and support others to succeed.

The successful candidate will have:

    Tertiary education and experience in wood science, civil / structural engineering or related fields
    Deep knowledge of mass timber products and their use in construction
    Strong communication skills, especially explaining scientific and technical topics in a way that non-experts can understand
    An analytical approach, basing decisions on facts and using data effectively
    Scientific and technical literacy and experience in research projects
    The ability to engage with a wide range of people and job roles and with external stakeholders
    Fluent written and spoken English. Fluency in Swedish is an advantage

What we offer 

You will be part of our diverse working culture which supports you in exploring new perspectives and developing professionally. You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as sustainability and innovation are at the core of our strategy. To keep you going safely, we support your physical and mental well-being. 

General benefits include:

    Career growth opportunities within an international organisation 
    Hybrid work options and flexible working hours 
    Access to modern technologies and digital tools 
    Professional development opportunities 
    Motivating additional benefits package 
    Inspiring, sustainable, and innovation-driven work environment 
    

Location specific benefits are also provided. These vary depending on the location and country of your employment.    

Join the Renewable Materials Company 

Stora Enso is the leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials, and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees. 

You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that anything made from fossil-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow.

Watch our film: Be part of a nature positive future 

Read more about working at Stora Enso: Who we are - Careers | Stora Enso 

How can you apply for this role?

Please submit your application through our recruitment tool on our web site storaenso.com/careers . We review candidates on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, and no later than 9 August 2026. 

Our recruitment process can include pre-employment actions such as background, reference and health checks as well as a drug test.  

We believe diversity strengthens our competitiveness and contributes to better decision-making. Diverse working teams help us to explore different perspectives and challenge our way of thinking. We work actively to increase diversity in the workplace and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds. Stora Enso is an equal opportunity employer and follows non-discriminatory practices.

title: People & Culture Manager
description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as People & Culture Manager!

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future with one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

About Swedish Match

Swedish Match develops, manufactures and sells high-quality smoke-free products. In the Nordic region, we are 1,800 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.

In 2023, the company became part of Philip Morris International, and our products are now the cornerstone of the newly formed global category for oral smoke-free products. Please read more about us at www.swedishmatch.com and www.pmi.com.

Our two Swedish factories are located in the Gothenburg area, and we are now looking for a dynamic People & Culture Manager for our factory in Kungälv. In this pivotal role, you will support our ongoing transformation by driving people initiatives, strengthening organizational effectiveness, and enabling business success in a rapidly evolving environment.

Your role

As People & Culture Manager, you will be a trusted partner to the factory management team and will provide both strategic and operational People & Culture support, partnering closely with leaders across the factory.

You will be part of a collaborative and engaged People & Culture team of four, supporting Operations across the Nordics. Reporting to the Sr Manager People & Culture Nordics, you will be based at our factory in Kungälv and work closely with People & Culture colleagues in Gothenburg, Stockholm, and Silkeborg, Denmark.



Your Main Responsibilities

    Partner with factory leadership team to translate business needs into clear people priorities and plans
    Build managerial capabilities and coach managers on change, organizational design, performance, employee relations and rewards
    Lead and support labor relations, union negotiations and compliance with Swedish employment practices
    Drive workforce planning, competence development, succession planning and talent initiatives
    Work with managers to build a positive work environment by planning and implementing initiatives that improve collaboration, employee well-being, and inclusion
    In collaborations with subject matter experts, contribute to the development and roll-out of P&C policies and programs (e.g., talent, L&D, compensation, etc.)
    Analyze and interpret key people data to identify trends and talent needs; communicate findings and recommendations to the business



Who you are:

    You are an experienced HR professional with a bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Organization Development or equivalent
    You bring at least five years of HR Business Partner experience from a multinational organization, preferably in a production environment
    You build trusted relationships, influence stakeholders and coach leaders with confidence
    You have a broad HR toolbox, including talent and performance management, organizational development, change management, labor relations, learning and employee engagement
    You combine strong execution with an analytical mindset, using people data to identify trends and recommend actions
    You have sound knowledge of Swedish labor law and experience in union negotiations
    You communicate clearly and confidently in both English and Swedish
    

Please note that relocation support is not available for this role.

What We Offer

Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join us at Swedish Match and you too can:

    Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to experiment, explore and learn.
    Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.
    Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.
    Join an inclusive and diverse culture where every contribution is valued, collaboration is encouraged, and everyone can feel they belong.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
At Koenigsegg, we bring together curious minds and skilled engineers who share a passion for pushing technology forward. As part of our R&D team, you will work in a collaborative environment where ideas grow into world-class innovations.

We are currently expanding our R&D team and are looking for Mechanical Design Engineering with experience in areas such as interior design, exterior design, vehicle systems and standard components and materials.

The role offers the opportunity to contribute to the design and development of components and systems that define the performance, functionality, and quality of our cars. You will be surrounded by dedicated colleagues who value teamwork, precision, and creativity in every step of the process.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for the design and development of components and systems within the R&D Engineering department. This will include all development phases from conceptual design to end of production, and will require close collaboration with all parts of the organization, including but not limited to; Prototype, Testing, Procurement, Production, Quality, CAE and Homologation departments.

You will:

    Design mechanical systems & solutions with emphasis on performance and quality using a ‘first principles’ approach
    Generate 3D models, assemblies and 2D drawings using Catia V6 / 3DExperience
    Design and facilitate tests to verify component function and that requirements are met
    Carry out data analysis to perform root cause analysis, promote reliability and improve performance
    Assist in selecting and interacting with suppliers and technology providers to ensure quality and performance targets are met
    Work closely with the Prototype dept. during concept validation phase
    Provide technical support leading to successful introduction of components and systems into and throughout production
    Assist in the creation of design standards and help to enforce them within the team
    Mentor entry-level engineers

Requirements:

    Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
    5+ years of experience in engineering design for Automotive/Aerospace or similar industries.
    Proven understanding of assembly design, DFM and durability of components
    5+ years Advanced CAD capabilities (CATIA V5/V6 or 3DEXPERIENCE)
    Proven experience of working with FEA
    GD&T design and application
    Proof of previous design of components for state-of-the-art manufacturing methods

Meritorious experience:

    Work experience from top tier automotive or motorsport industry
    Practical hands-on experience working with cars/racing or similar (either professional or hobby)
    Material science (material selection, heat treatment and surface treatments etc.)
    Vehicle Architecture and packaging
    Previous leadership experience

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply. We look forward to receiving your application!

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 500 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

title: Responsable de projets du maître d'ouvrage
employer: Office fédéral constructions et logistique OFCL
description:
Responsable de projets du maître d'ouvrage  
Berne, Suisse \| 80\-100%  
Ce à quoi vous pouvez contribuer  
Assumer la responsabilité générale de projets de construction complexes pour le compte du maître d'ouvrage, du choix de la procédure à la remise à notre client, en passant par l'étude de projet et la réalisation  
Définir les objectifs et les risques du projet, établir les bases stratégiques (planification du processus, modèles de réalisation et étapes de la procédure) ainsi que diriger les organisations de projet interdisciplinaires  
Planifier, solliciter et piloter les ressources humaines et financières ; gérer les crédits de projet conformément aux prescriptions légales, notamment la loi sur les finances de la Confédération  
Assurer une collaboration efficace avec les utilisateurs, les exploitants, les mandataires, les entreprises et les consultants spécialisés dans l'intérêt de la Confédération en sa qualité de maître d'ouvrage  
Mener des procédures d'adjudication conformément à la loi et à l'ordonnance sur les marchés publics (LMP et OMP), et garantir une gestion efficace de la qualité et du controlling des projets  
Ce qui vous rend unique  
Diplôme reconnu en architecture, en ingénierie civile ou formation équivalente dans le secteur de la construction  
Expérience de plusieurs années dans la conduite générale de projets de construction complexes, complétée par une solide expérience dans la représentation du maître d'ouvrage  
Compétences attestées en conduite générale de projets (qualité, coûts et délais) et connaissance des marchés publics (LMP et OMP)  
Excellentes compétences en conduite, pensée stratégique et conforme aux principes de l'économie d'entreprise  
Grande aptitude à créer des réseaux et aisance communicationnelle  
Connaissance active de deux langues officielles  
En quelques mots  
En tant que représentant/e du maître d'ouvrage à l'OFCL, l'organe de la Confédération spécialisé dans la construction, vous assumerez la responsabilité générale de projets exigeants dans toute la Suisse. À ce poste clé, vous dirigerez l'organisation interdisciplinaire de projets, piloterez des processus complexes conformément à des objectifs clairement définis. Vous assumerez également la responsabilité de la qualité, des coûts et du respect des délais dans l'intérêt public. Il s'agit d'une activité stratégique avec des responsabilités importantes, dont les résultats influencent directement le développement du patrimoine immobilier de la Confédération.  
Ce que nous offrons  
Travailler pour la Suisse Nous nous engageons pour le succès du modèle suisse et pour le bien\-être de la population.  
La diversité au quotidien Nous veillons à l'égalité des chances, qui nous permet de déployer nos compétences et d'exprimer des points de vue différents.  
Santé au travail Nous assistons et conseillons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs pour toutes les questions liées à la santé physique ou psychique.  
Tous les avantages  
Des tâches et des projets de construction passionnants vous attendent!  
À l'OFCL, construire, acquérir, déménager, conseiller font partie de notre ADN. Chaque jour, nous donnons le meilleur de nous\-mêmes avec un maximum d'enthousiasme pour la Suisse, la politique et l'administration fédérale. Notre office veille à ce que les 43 000 employés de la Confédération puissent accomplir leurs tâches. Ce faisant, nous façonnons non seulement leur travail, mais nous établissons également de nouveaux standards en matière de durabilité.

FER CIAM "" L'humain au centre des prestations sociales  
La FER CIAM est l'agence genevoise de la plus grande caisse interprofessionnelle AVS de Suisse FER Genève, créée par la FER Genève et pleinement intégrée dans son écosystème de services aux entreprises membres.

Aisance avec les chiffres et l'analyse financière, les outils informatiques et Excel

title: European Legal Counsel
description:
European Legal Counsel (One\-Year Maternity Cover)  
Start date: Between October and November 2026 (subject to agreement)  
We are looking for a European lawyer to join our legal team on a maternity cover basis. This is an in\-house role for a lawyer who has a broad skillset and practical experience across a wide range of legal topics — spanning sustainability, HSEC, human rights, regulatory compliance, employment, and corporate and contract law. The selected candidate will work closely with teams across Glencore's industrial and marketing operations, providing practical, solutions\-oriented advice across a diverse range of matters.  
The main tasks and responsibilities include:  
Oversee legal aspects of HSEC and human rights programmes, including regulatory compliance and risk management.  
Provide legal support to the Responsible Sourcing team in connection with Glencore's responsible sourcing programme.  
Support the Sustainability and HSEC \& human rights teams on issues management, including stakeholder engagement and related legal risk.  
Provide legal advice and support on sustainability initiatives, including the development and implementation of policies and strategies to promote environmental stewardship and social responsibility.  
Monitor European regulatory developments across natural resources, mining, and energy, and advise on applicability and implementation implications.  
Draft, review, and negotiate a variety of commercial agreements for various parts of the business.  
Advise on employment law matters, including employment contracts, labour relations, and employee benefits.  
Support the Corporate Affairs teams with legal guidance on external communications, and reputational matters.  
The ideal candidate  
Degree in law and bar admission with additional qualifications such as an LL.M. or equivalent preferred.  
3\-5 years of post\-graduate experience in a generalist in\-house or private practice role, with exposure to some or all of the following: sustainability, HSEC, human rights, employment, commercial law and regulatory compliance.  
Full professional proficiency in either German or French, with fluent English language skills (written and verbal), Spanish language skills an advantage.  
Experience working in industrial or regulated sectors such as mining, energy, or manufacturing is highly desirable.  
Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and work in a fast\-paced, multinational environment.  
Effective analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.  
Ability to build trusted relationships with different teams.  
Motivated and keen to develop skills and knowledge.  
A collaborative team member with a high level of trust and integrity.  
Basic familiarity with AI tools and an interest in using them to improve efficiency is an advantage.  
Holding a Swiss work permit or passport holder of CH / EU / EFTA.  
Benefits  
We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.  
We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.  
We provide tuition assistance for further education and training courses.  
We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.  
Employees’ Swiss Pension 2nd pillar is fully paid by Glencore.  
Who we are  
Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.  
With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.  
Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist (80\-100%)  
We are looking for a Employee Services Coordinator to join our Reception, Relocation and Corporate Housing Team at our headquarters in Baar. For motivated candidates, we offer the chance to join one of the world’s largest producers and marketers of commodities and to become part of a multicultural team.  
The main tasks and responsibilities include  
Welcoming and supporting our international guests and visitors as the company's first point of contact  
Focal point for employees for general questions about services offered by the company  
Operation of the telephone exchange (internal and external)  
Booking taxis and other transfers  
Management of our meeting rooms  
Support the Relocation and Corporate Flat Management Team by providing dedicated assistance to relocating employees and delivering an exceptional service experience, including support with home search, school placement, and settling\-in matters. Ensure a smooth and comfortable start to their new life abroad by offering personalized hospitality services within our company apartments.  
Various administrative tasks  
The ideal candidate  
Communicates confidently with international guests and employees in both German and English, demonstrating strong interpersonal and team communication skills  
Thrives in a multicultural environment and contributes to a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere through a professional and courteous manner  
Delivers high\-quality hospitality services and creates positive service experiences for employees and international guests  
Works independently with enthusiasm, reliability, and a strong service mindset, while maintaining a high standard of quality  
Effectively prioritizes tasks and remains calm, structured, and professional in fast\-paced or demanding situations  
Proactively contributes ideas and suggestions to improve services, processes, and the overall guest experience  
Actively contributes to a positive team spirit and collaborative working environment  
Qualifications and requirements  
Reception experience \- preferably from a hotel reception environment  
Very good knowledge of German and English (oral/written)  
High level of service awareness and team\-oriented working style  
Discreet and loyal personality  
Well\-groomed appearance and pleasant manners  
Holding a Swiss work permit or passport holder of CH / EU / EFTA  
Benefits  
We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.  
We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.  
We provide tuition assistance for further education and training courses.  
We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.  
Employees’ Swiss Pension 2nd pillar is fully paid by Glencore.  
Who we are  
Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.  
With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.  
Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

title: Assistant RH H/F, 80%, CDI - Gestion des ressources humaines
description:
Assistant RH H/F, 80%, CDI \- Gestion des ressources humaines  
Description de l'entreprise  
A l'Hospice général, nous œuvrons pour le mieux vivre ensemble à Genève  
Fondée en 1535 à Genève, notre institution accompagne les personnes qui, à un moment de leur vie, ont besoin d'un soutien le temps nécessaire pour (re)trouver une autonomie durable. Nous favorisons la réinsertion sociale et professionnelle des personnes à l'aide sociale, nous accueillons et hébergeons les personnes issues de l'asile que nous suivons dans leur parcours d'intégration. Enfin, nous participons à la lutte contre l'isolement des seniors.  
Nous sommes plus de 1' 600 collaboratrices et collaborateurs répartis sur 60 sites sur tout le territoire du canton. Nous accompagnons plus de 40' 000 personnes.  
En rejoignant notre institution, vous participerez à la réalisation de notre mission sociale, ancrée dans nos valeurs de collaboration, de respect, d'engagement et de bienveillance.  
Dans un contexte où nos équipes évoluent dans des domaines exigeants et en mutation constante, nous mettons un point d'honneur à leur proposer des conditions de travail stimulantes : nous visons la diversité et l'inclusion, nous valorisons l'intelligence collective, incitons aux échanges et à l'innovation et favorisons la prise d'initiative et l'expérimentation.  
Description du poste  
Vous êtes à la recherche d'un nouveau défi professionnel au sein d'une équipe motivée et dynamique ?  
Vous partagez nos valeurs d'engagement, de collaboration, de respect et de bienveillance et souhaitez contribuer à faire vivre la culture de notre institution ?  
Vous avez à cœur de développer des liens de confiance et des partenariats de proximité ? Vous aimez aborder les sujets de façon collective?  
Vous êtes peut\-être notre futur\-e collègue ! Rejoignez\-nous pour co\-construire la gestion des RH d'une institution en constante évolution !  
Votre mission  
Au sein d'une équipe composée d' RH, responsables RH, en recrutement et chargées d'acquisition des talents, ainsi qu'en coordination avec l'ensemble du département RH, vous contribuez à l'application et au développement de la gestion des ressources humaines. En fonction des périmètres qui vous sont confiés, vous intervenez dans différentes postures : appui aux processus RH, collaboration sur certains dossiers transversaux RH, rôle de référent ou coordination d'activités spécifiques.  
Vos principales activités  
Accueil et rôle de référence :  
Point d'entrée de la GRH, vous êtes répondant.e du service pour toutes les questions liées aux outils RH ;  
Grâce aux contacts de qualité et aux relations privilégiées que vous entretenez, tant avec les responsables qu'avec les collaborateurs, vous assurez la complémentarité avec les RRH pour permettre la remontée des informations ;  
Avec vos collègues RH, vous gérez l'accueil téléphonique et physique du service et contribuez ainsi à offrir un premier niveau de réponse de qualité aux collaborateurs et responsables hiérarchiques.  
Gestion administrative du cycle de vie du collaborateur :  
En collaboration avec les RRH, vos collègues RH et recrutement, vous organisez et gérez les activités administratives liées au cycle de vie du collaborateur (engagement, évolution, absences, changements de situation et départs) et des situations individuelles nécessitant un suivi spécifique ;  
Vous assurez la bonne tenue des dossiers du personnel dans le respect des normes de traçabilité (LIPAD), ainsi que la centralisation et la mise à jour de ces dossiers dans nos systèmes, garantissant ainsi une gestion sécurisée et fluide de l'information ;  
Vous garantissez la rédaction des comptes\-rendus et procès\-verbaux.  
Gestion des situations individuelles et sensibles :  
Vous assurez le suivi administratif des collaborateurs rencontrant des problématiques (santé, absence, etc.) et au besoin, vous vous appuyez sur un.e responsable RH pour les situations plus complexes ;  
Vous préparez, rédigez et assurez le suivi des courriers RH formels et sensibles (réponses aux recours, convocations, décisions RH).  
Contribution aux processus RH et au pilotage :  
Vous contribuez au pilotage et à l'anticipation des activités RH, en veillant à la fiabilité et à l'actualisation des données nécessaires aux statistiques permettant le suivi des principaux processus RH ;  
Véritable partenaire au sein de la GRH, vous êtes une aide à la prise de décision, par votre analyse et vos recherches complémentaires.  
Participation au recrutement :  
Vous accompagnez les processus de recrutement sur le plan administratif, en assurant le suivi des demandes avant leur publication, puis la gestion des étapes liées à l'engagement et ce jusqu'à l'intégration du nouveau collaborateur.  
Qualifications  
Votre profil  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une maturité professionnelle fédérale, complétée par un Certificat HRSE de Gestionnaire RH ou d'un titre jugé équivalent ;  
Vous êtes au bénéfice d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans l'exercice du métier, idéalement dans un domaine public régit par la B5 05 ;  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels (Word, Excel et Powerpoint) ;  
Vous démontrez une excellente organisation professionnelle et une bonne gestion du stress ;  
Vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse sont reconnues, tout comme vos qualités rédactionnelles ;  
Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour les contacts humains ;  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement complexe et en pleine évolution en termes de processus, procédures et cadres juridiques ;  
Vous possédez une bonne capacité d'intégration et de remise en question ;  
Vous faites preuve de rigueur, de conscience professionnelle et respectez en tout temps la confidentialité ;  
Une expérience dans l'accompagnement des apprentis et l'attestation de formatrices et formateurs d'apprenti\-e\-s serait un atout.  
Informations supplémentaires  
Nous vous proposons  
Une culture d'entreprise ouverte et respectueuse ;  
Un développement continu des compétences grâce à une politique de formation attractive ;  
Des opportunités d'évolution de carrière et de mobilité interne ;  
De vraies solutions pour favoriser un équilibre vie professionnelle\-vie privée ;  
De nombreuses activités culturelles et sportives à vivre en collectif au sein de l'institution.  
Taux d'activité : 80%  
Type de contrat : CDI  
Classe de fonction : 14  
Entrée en fonction :

Notre processus de recrutement  
Il se déroule en plusieurs phases selon le type de poste, où chaque étape conditionne la suivante : analyse de candidature, entretien téléphonique, entretiens de recrutement avec la hiérarchie et les ressources humaines et le cas échéant, test métier et/ou évaluation type assessement pour les postes de management et certains postes spécifiques.  
Ce poste vous intéresse ?  
Le service de recrutement de l'Hospice général se réjouit de recevoir votre candidature complète (lettre de motivation, CV, diplôme de plus haut niveau de formation atteint, certificats de travail). Do you enjoy working with numbers and do you want to create financial transparency that effectively supports management decisions? As a Cost Controlling Expert, you will play a central role in our team: you will be responsible for planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, provide key figures to Senior Management, and drive the proactive management of costs at Generali Switzerland. This position is offered on a fixed\-term basis and is scheduled to end on 31 January 2027\.  
Cost Controlling Expert (m/f/d) \- Temporary Contract until January 31st, 2027  
SUCCESS AT WORK AND AT HOME.  
Navigating real life together.  
What to expect  
You are responsible for the operational activities of the cost controlling processes, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, analysis and cost allocation, as well as the timely provision of relevant key figures to various stakeholders (CFO, Executive Committee and Generali Head Office)  
You are responsible for cost in the areas of IT, technology \& operations, as well as project costs of Generali Switzerland, working in close collaboration with the business and the project portfolio management team  
You stabilize and optimize existing structures, processes and data flows in cost controlling, for example the regular forecasting process  
You support the development and operational implementation of processes for the proactive cost management of Generali Switzerland  
You handle ad hoc management requests and analyses related to costs  
The skills you'll bring  
You have a university or university of applied sciences degree in business, economics, or a similar field  
You bring at least five years of professional experience in controlling; specific experience in cost controlling and/or in the insurance industry is an advantage  
You have strong analytical and conceptual skills  
You have a strong can\-do attitude and are motivated to actively shape the future of cost controlling at Generali Switzerland  
You communicate professionally with stakeholders of all levels in English. German proficiency is an advantage

Your office? It's wherever you are! Depending on your workload, you can work up to 60% of your hours remotely – for more flexibility at work and at home.

Your health is very important to us. At our company, you can keep fit alongside your colleagues in a wide range of sports groups.

We, Generali  
Generali is committed to equal opportunities. We welcome you regardless of age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity or religion.

Conseiller·ère en projets sanitaires  
Proposez des solutions techniques innovantes dès les premières phases des projets

Rattaché·e à la Direction de la gestion des objets, vous identifiez et développez des opportunités de projets sur votre région en intervenant dès les premières phases de construction (SIA 1 à 4\), afin de positionner des solutions globales à forte valeur ajoutée. Au bénéfice d’une formation dans la technique du bâtiment, idéalement complétée par une formation supérieure dans les domaines sanitaire ou chauffage (brevet, maîtrise fédérale, ES ou équivalent), vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée dans la planification, la gestion de projets et la vente technique, acquise au sein d’un bureau d’étude ou d’une entreprise d’installation. description:
Senior Quality Specialist  
The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with 92\.6 billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. It is present in 187 countries around the world, has 403 factories and its 291'000 employees are committed to Nestlé's purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Nestlé offers a wide portfolio of products and services for people and their pets throughout their lives. Its more than 2000 brands range from global icons like Nescafé or Nespresso to local favourites. Company performance is driven by its Nutrition, Health and Wellness strategy. Nestlé is based in the Swiss town of Vevey where it was founded more than 150 years ago. Learn more about our Group and reasons to join us on  
Senior Quality Specialist  
Location: Orbe, Switzerland  
Work model: Office\-based / Full time  
Contract type / duration: Permanent  
Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.  
As a Senior Quality Specialist at Société des Produits Nestlé, your mission is to build trust and deliver the best consumer experience for beverage systems by ensuring food safety, compliance and quality by design. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, quality teams, business stream managers, manufacturing partners, regulatory and legal experts, and suppliers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.  
How you'll make an impact as a Senior Quality Specialist  
Promoting quality by design across beverage system development so teams deliver safe, compliant and consumer\-focused innovations.  
Driving right\-first\-time quality for new systems, products, packaging and filling lines from early development through technical approval.  
Building robust validation plans and quality sign\-offs that align partners, strengthen decisions and reduce risks before launch.  
Ensuring food safety, product compliance and quality standards are embedded into development, manufacturing and supplier activities.  
Providing technical expertise to factories and consumer service teams so quality issues are resolved effectively and improvements are sustained.  
Sharing lessons learned, tools and expertise across sites to grow quality capabilities and support continuous improvement.  
What will make you successful  
Bringing strong quality, manufacturing, research and development, and beverage systems expertise to complex innovation projects, ideally supported by a degree or equivalent qualification in science, chemistry or packaging.  
Applying food safety, hazard analysis, product compliance, good manufacturing practices, verification and audit knowledge with confidence, with a certificate or master's in regulatory affairs or chemistry considered an advantage.  
Using problem\-solving, change management and continuous improvement skills to protect consumers and improve quality outcomes.  
Collaborating across functions, sites and external partners with clear communication, coaching skills and a solution\-focused mindset.  
Communicating fluently in English.  
Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.  
At Société des Produits Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Learning and development opportunities to grow your career  
Performance based bonus  
Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.  
The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
description:
Strategic Sourcing Manager

Purpose of the role:

  *  Developing and executing global sourcing strategies for the assigned direct materials categories: e.g. machining parts (focus on turning and milling), Welding parts etc.
  *  Acting as a business partner to key stakeholders in business (Business Units, Engineering, etc.) and Operations (Product Line Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Production, Materials Management, etc.)
  *  The global category manager shall sustain the Global Strategic Sourcing Operating Model and provide the supply capability and capacity at best cost to support the company’s future business needs and protection of brand value
  *  Application of aligned sourcing processes, sustainable supplier assessments and development approach, a performing and regulatory compliant supply base footprint shall be established and actively managed, contributing to the enhancement of the supply base performance on Quality, Delivery and Cost (QCD)
  *  Realization of a measurable value >3% in recurring and P&L effective cost reductions per year across the global 3rd party spend in the assigned spend categories accompanied by a leveraged and benchmarked supply base management
  *  Grow and further develop a qualified and performing Best Cost Country Supply Base in line with the companies and operations BCC objectives preferably in Eastern Europe and manage a sustainable spend allocation


Responsibilities:

  *  Management of own material categories (capacity, knowledge management, performance)                
  *  Accountable for contributing to the global Direct Material & Supply Base Performance (QCD)        
  *  Representing own direct material categories within the VAT organization                              
  *  Accountable for the category specific achievement of the objectives of cost optimization, supply base optimization, geographic sourcing footprint and Best Cost Country Sourcing                          
  *  Providing forward-looking guidance on trends, threats and opportunities in own categories (eg. raw materials etc.)                          
  *  Active contribution to the bottom up alignment of the Direct Materials Category Team with the defined / set company objectives                                
  *  Interface to BU / Engineering for Strategic Sourcing activities along with the PDP (IP07) process  
  *  Act as a change agent in regards to main stakeholders
  *  Perform the development of category sourcing strategies applying and complying with defined methods and tools
  *  Active supplier relationship management of the global supply base within its own category perimeter in alignment with the category teams in Switzerland, Malaysia and Romania
  *  Ensure consistent application of all Sourcing Levers
  *  Contribution to main Sourcing KPIs
  *  Assembles and actively leads category specific / cross-functional sourcing board
  *  Actively monitors and performs a supply base risk assessment across its own categories
  *  Participates in and contributes to continuous improvement of direct material practices  


Qualifications:  

  *  5+ years in-depth strategic and operational sourcing experience with a solid working knowledge of global category management
  *  Demonstrated work experience on category specific production techniques and processes
  *  Knowledge about category sourcing markets
  *  Office Software / IT application (esp. Excel, Word, Power Point etc.)
  *  Sourcing in Eastern Europe, Asia and experience in Best Cost Country and spend relocation activities
  *  Working experience within a global complex organization
  *  Experience in the field of machine building, vacuum technology and semiconductors
  *  Cross-function / category team management (min. functional)
  *  Sensible and emphatic communication skills with suppliers, colleagues, internal stakeholders, etc.
  *  Strong analytical skills (risk based) and focus on the essential facts
  *  Able to get results through others, able to multi-task, sense of priority, able to handle stress levels
  *  Good communication skills in German and English (any other language will be a plus)

title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description:
Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.
Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.

Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.

Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen als

Internistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Die folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.

- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.
- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:
Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.
- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:
Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.
- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:
Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.
- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:
Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.
- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:
Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.
- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:
Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.
- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:
In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.
- Umfassende Betreuung:
Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.
- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:
Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen

Eine Ikone unter den Hotels: 1873 begann die Geschichte des Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne \- eine Geschichte, die bis heute beeindruckt und berührt. Hoch oben auf dem Bürgenberg liegt eine Oase der Entspannung und ein Ort erstklassiger Gastfreundschaft. Das Bürgenstock Resort und seine rund 700 Mitarbeitenden aus 54 Nationen bietet den perfekten Rahmen für schillernde Momente, die in Erinnerung bleiben.  
Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zehn Restaurants, Bars \& Lounges sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Bürgenstock Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  
Das Resort belegt Platz 4 der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz 2023 in der Kategorie Gastronomie, Tourismus, Beherbergung, Entertainment und Freizeit, und erhielt die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz 2025\. Zwei Auszeichnungen, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n  
Ihre Aufgaben  
Als Housekeeping Manager (w/m/i) stellen Sie gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team sicher, dass die hohen Standards des Bürgenstock Resorts in den Bereichen Sauberkeit, Servicequalität und Gästekomfort jederzeit gewährleistet sind. In dieser Funktion rapportieren Sie direkt an den Director of Housekeeping und unterstützen ihn bei der operativen sowie strategischen Führung des Verantwortungsbereichs Rooms.  
Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören:  
Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Teams von ca. 50 Mitarbeitenden, darunter Supervisoren, Zimmermädchen und Portiers  
Sicherstellung der Reinigung und Pflege von Zimmern sowie öffentlichen Bereichen  
Überwachung und Einhaltung von Hygienestandards und Sicherheitsrichtlinien  
Effiziente Planung und Organisation der Arbeitsabläufe, Dienstpläne und Ressourcen  
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um ein nahtloses Gästeerlebnis zu gewährleisten  
Verantwortung für die Budgetkontrolle und die Umsetzung nachhaltiger Reinigungs\- und Arbeitsprozesse  
Organisation und Überwachung der täglichen Arbeitsabläufe und Personaleinsätze  
Motivation und Schulung des Teams, um eine kontinuierliche Qualität und individuelle Entwicklung sicherzustellen  
Sie haben die Ausbildung zur Hotelfachfrau EFZ oder Fachfrau Hauswirtschaft erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bringen mindestens zwei Jahre Führungserfahrung aus einer ähnlichen Funktion mit. Sie sprechen Deutsch und Englisch, sind dienstleistungsorientiert und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig und effizient. Sie sind sich eine selbständige Arbeitsweise gewohnt und können sich und Ihre Mitarbeiter gut organisieren und motivieren. Sie sind zuverlässig und arbeiten gern im Team. Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind eine Ihrer grossen Stärken. Wenn Sie ausserdem noch den Berufsbildnerkurs absolviert haben, so ist dies von Vorteil. Wir erwarten ein gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten. Fremdsprachen sind ein zusätzliches Plus im Umgang mit unseren Mitarbeitern und Gästen.  
Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige Tätigkeit in einem tollen Team und mit vielen Benefits, wie das Personalhaus mit Fitnessstudio, TV\-Lounge, Billardraum und Bibliothek. Sie erhalten Ermässigungen in den Restaurants, im Hotel für Übernachtung für Sie und Ihre Familie und Freunde, Ermässigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel sowie Versicherungen. title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist (80\-100%)  
We are looking for a Employee Services Coordinator to join our Reception, Relocation and Corporate Housing Team at our headquarters in Baar. For motivated candidates, we offer the chance to join one of the world’s largest producers and marketers of commodities and to become part of a multicultural team.  
The main tasks and responsibilities include  
Welcoming and supporting our international guests and visitors as the company's first point of contact  
Focal point for employees for general questions about services offered by the company  
Operation of the telephone exchange (internal and external)  
Booking taxis and other transfers  
Management of our meeting rooms  
Support the Relocation and Corporate Flat Management Team by providing dedicated assistance to relocating employees and delivering an exceptional service experience, including support with home search, school placement, and settling\-in matters. Ensure a smooth and comfortable start to their new life abroad by offering personalized hospitality services within our company apartments.  
Various administrative tasks  
The ideal candidate  
Communicates confidently with international guests and employees in both German and English, demonstrating strong interpersonal and team communication skills  
Thrives in a multicultural environment and contributes to a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere through a professional and courteous manner  
Delivers high\-quality hospitality services and creates positive service experiences for employees and international guests  
Works independently with enthusiasm, reliability, and a strong service mindset, while maintaining a high standard of quality  
Effectively prioritizes tasks and remains calm, structured, and professional in fast\-paced or demanding situations  
Proactively contributes ideas and suggestions to improve services, processes, and the overall guest experience  
Actively contributes to a positive team spirit and collaborative working environment  
Qualifications and requirements  
Reception experience \- preferably from a hotel reception environment  
Very good knowledge of German and English (oral/written)  
High level of service awareness and team\-oriented working style  
Discreet and loyal personality  
Well\-groomed appearance and pleasant manners  
Holding a Swiss work permit or passport holder of CH / EU / EFTA  
Benefits  
We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.  
We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.  
We provide tuition assistance for further education and training courses.  
We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.  
Employees’ Swiss Pension 2nd pillar is fully paid by Glencore.  
Who we are  
Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.  
With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.  
Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

title: Legal Officer Internal Market Division - Brussels
description:
Legal Officer Internal Market Division \- Brussels  
Do you want to be a part of a dynamic and ambitious intergovernmental organisation working for the promotion of free trade and economic integration across Europe and globally? The European Free Trade Association (EFTA) offers the opportunity for a motivated and highly skilled professional to join the Internal Market Division in Brussels as a Legal Officer. Here, you will be part of an organisation based on professionalism, cooperation, trust, responsibility and respect.  
The EFTA Secretariat serves the four EFTA States – Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland – and has offices in Geneva, Brussels and Luxemburg. The Brussels Office supports the EEA EFTA States in the management of the EEA Agreement and assists in preparing new legislation for integration into the Agreement.  
The Internal Market Division (IMD) is responsible for providing support and assistance to the EFTA States in their work related to the EEA Agreement and their contribution to the development of EEA\-relevant legislation.  
Division Internal Market Division Location Brussels Category/Level A4 Type/Duration of Appointment Fixed term three years. If considered desirable and in the organisation’s interest, an additional three\-year contract may be offered. Start Date Autumn 2026 Job Reference VA 14/2026  
Role Description  
We are looking for a highly motivated and qualified candidate to take on the rewardingpost as legal officer in IMD. The successful candidate will play an important role in IMD, cooperating closely with and providing legal advice to colleagues and to the EEA EFTA States.  
The main tasks of the successful applicant will be to:  
Provide legal services and advice to the EEA EFTA States and colleagues in IMD within a wide selection of policy areas covered by the EEA Agreement, Draft Decisions of the EEA Joint Committee to incorporate EEA\-relevant EU legal acts into the EEA Agreement,Draft legal and explanatory notes related to the management of the EEA Agreement,Cooperate closely with the IMD policy officers, administrative coordinators, Registrar and other members of EFTA’s EEA legal team,Cooperate closely with Ministries in the EEA EFTA States, the EFTA Missions to the EU and EU counterparts regarding the incorporation of EU legislation into the EEA Agreement, andContribute to EFTA’s outreach activities, sharing knowledge and building competence on how the EEA Agreement functions and its legal implications, by giving trainings and presentations in meetings and seminars.  
The successful candidate should be flexible and willing to take on other tasks, including non\-legal and administrative tasks, as required, and depending on the workload and needs within IMD.  
Essential Skills  
University master’s degree in lawMinimum five years relevant work experience in a national administration, international organisation, or other relevant private sector companyExperience working with EEA or EU law  
Excellent analytical skills and focus on results  
Ability to draft legal texts and opinions concisely, clearly, and swiftly in English Excellent organisational and communication skillsSelf\-reliance and autonomy, together with a facility for teamwork in a task\-oriented environmentFlexibility with a positive, service\-minded, and proactive attitude  
Ideal Skills  
Experience working in an international and multicultural environment  
A postgraduate degree in EEA and/or European Union law  
Interest and knowledge of new IT tools, included AI\-based solutions Working knowledge of German, Norwegian or Icelandic  
Employment Terms  
EFTA has a dynamic and diverse work environment with the opportunity to work in a team of highly qualified people. Here you will be part of an organisation based on professionalism, cooperation, trust, responsibility and respect.  
EFTA also offers:  
International career and learning opportunities. An inclusive environment with high regard for cultural differences. Competitive benefit package.  
Grade: A4  
Annual salary: EUR 117,072\.48  
Appointments are normally made at the first step of the grade. The Secretary\-General reserves the right to appoint a candidate at a level different from that advertised. Through its recruitment policy, the EFTA Secretariat wants to ensure diversity in terms of gender, age and culture.  
EFTA is an international organisation, and the salaries and related payments are normally exempt from income taxation by the EFTA Member States and in the host states of the EFTA duty stations. Depending on the candidate’s family status, benefits and allowances may apply.  
This position is open to nationals of all the EFTA States (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland). Applicants must apply via the EFTA e\-recruitment tool.  
The EFTA Secretariat aims to ensure balanced representation of EEA EFTA States in the Division and specifically in the Legal Unit of IMD. We therefore encourage Norwegian and Liechtensteiner candidates to apply for this Legal Officer role.

title: Global Evidence Generation Director Rare Disease 100%
description:
Director Global Evidence Generation Rare Disease

Global Medical Affairs

Global Rare Disease

Novo Nordisk



Are you motivated to shape how evidence is generated, integrated and translated into impact for people living with rare diseases? Do you combine strategic evidence leadership with the drive to turn scientific strategy into high-quality execution, launch readiness and stakeholder value?

This senior role in Global Medical Affairs Rare Disease will set the direction for evidence generation across the Rare Disease portfolio while staying close to delivery. You will ensure evidence strategies are robust, actionable, and aligned with business priorities — translating plans into impactful studies, scientific communication, and practical insights that support decision-making.



Your new role

As Global Evidence Generation Director, you will lead and drive the global evidence generation strategy for Rare Disease in close partnership with therapy area medical teams, regions, key affiliates, clinical development, market access, commercial, safety, regulatory and external scientific stakeholders.  

You will be accountable for translating medical and business priorities into an integrated evidence generation approach that supports clinical practice change, scientific communication, and stakeholder engagement. The role requires strategic judgement, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to ensure that evidence activities are prioritised, compliant, scientifically robust and aligned with the Rare Disease ambition.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Shape and lead the integrated evidence strategy across the Rare Disease portfolio and brands, ensuring evidence plans are aligned with therapy area strategies and business priorities.

Drive design and execution of priority real world evidence (RWE) and Investigator Sponsored Study (ISS) activities, providing expert input on study concepts, coordinating delivery across teams and markets, and ensuring evidence generation supports launch and lifecycle goals.

Lead and coordinate the evidence team, including Evidence Generation Associate Directors and Project Managers, ensuring clear priorities, strong execution, progress tracking and delivery against timelines, budgets and impact.

Translate evidence into impact, working with Publications, Scientific Communication and cross-functional teams to ensure study outputs are communicated effectively and embedded into key scientific dialogue deliverables.

Build evidence generation capability, acting as a subject matter expert and mentor for the evidence team and wider Medical Affairs organisation.

Partner across the enterprise, building strong collaboration with Medical Affairs, Commercial, Market Access, R&D, affiliates, RWE/Data Science experts and external stakeholders to address portfolio evidence needs.

Contribute to Medical Affairs functional leadership team, helping set direction, prioritise resources, develop talent and strengthen a state-of-the-art Medical Affairs organisation focused on advancing patient care.



Your new department  

You will join Global Medical Affairs Rare Disease, a global organisation dedicated to improving outcomes for people living with rare diseases. The team works across therapy areas and functional disciplines to generate insights, shape medical strategy, drive scientific dialogue, support clinical care pathways, and build organisational readiness for current and future assets.

The Evidence Generation function plays a central role in ensuring that our strategies are supported by high-quality evidence and that evidence activities are focused on the questions that matter most for patients, healthcare professionals, payers, regulators and healthcare systems. You will work with highly skilled colleagues across the global Rare Disease organisation and with regional and affiliate teams in key markets.



Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for a strategic, collaborative and scientifically strong leader who can operate with confidence in a global, matrixed organisation. You combine evidence generation expertise with a clear understanding of Medical Affairs impact, external stakeholder needs, cross-functional team needs and the realities of launch and lifecycle management.

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

Over 10 years of evidence generation experience within the pharmaceutical or pharmaceutical service industry, including global, regional, or multi-country exposure, ideally in rare disease or specialty care.  

Proven track record in influential leadership and ability to build and drive high-performing evidence activities and complex strategic projects

Strong understanding of pharmaceutical governance, compliance, quality and ethical requirements related to evidence generation and external collaborations.

Proven ability to build teams and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority, influence senior stakeholders and translate complex evidence topics into clear strategic recommendations.

Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to create alignment, present to senior audiences and engage credibly with scientific experts.

A structured, impact-oriented approach to prioritisation, resource allocation and execution in a complex global environment.



Working at Novo Nordisk

At Novo Nordisk, we do not wait for change. We drive it. We are a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future. We embrace experimentation, strive for excellence without fixating on perfection, and never shy away from opportunities to develop. From research and development to manufacturing, marketing, medical affairs and sales, we are all working to move the needle on patient care.





Deadline

Please apply by Aug 31st. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.



Equality of opportunity

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. At Novo Nordisk we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to aspire to be the best company for the world, and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and the communities we operate in.



Together, we are changing life

Join us in shaping evidence that can help transform the future of care for people living with rare diseases.

title: Test Engineer for unit testing HS/SW
description:
Test Engineer for unit testing HS/SW  
Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are based here. For our long\-standing client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for an  
Test Engineer for unit testing HS/SW  
Background:  
We are looking for a Senior Test Engineer with a strong focus on Hardware Unit and Subsystem Testing to strengthen the cross\-functional engineering team. In this role, you will be the driving force ensuring the quality, robustness, and reliability of hardware units to ensure their seamless integration into the system level.  
We are seeking experienced Test Engineers (5\+ years) with a strong background in HW/SW testing within highly regulated medical or IVD environments. You possess a deep understanding of the V\-model and are proficient in ALM/Agile tools (Codebeamer/Jira).  
We are hiring across four specialized profiles corresponding to the functional units: Measurement Chamber, Fluidics Component, Oximetry, and HW Unit \& Subsystem.  
You will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of Blood Gas \& Electrolytes (BG/E) Analyzers, ensuring the medical diagnostic devices meet the highest standards of safety and efficacy. This collaborative, high\-impact position is located at the site in Rotkreuz, Switzerland, and offers the flexibility to tailor responsibilities to your unique strengths.  
Tasks \& Responsibilities:  
Test Development \& Execution: You will design, prepare, and execute automated test suites, test cases, and test protocols for Verification and Validation (V\&V) in strict compliance with medical device regulations (FDA/MDR)  
Endurance \& Reliability Testing: You will develop and run accelerated life testing (ALT), durability, and wear\-and\-tear tests to ensure the long\-term performance and reliability of hardware components under real\-world conditions  
Fixture Design \& Automation: You will build and assemble custom test setups, fluidic rigs, and test fixtures (utilizing CAD tools like SolidWorks) and integrate sensors, pumps, and actuators into these setups  
Scripting \& Data Analysis: You will write automation scripts in to control test rigs and gather data, while also analyzing complex test metrics using statistical tools  
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: You will conduct root cause analysis (such as 5 Whys and Fishbone diagrams) for defects, provide design feedback for manufacturability (DFM/DFA), and collaborate closely with software, firmware, and systems engineering teams on continuous improvements  
Individual Tasks \& Responsibilities per profile:  
Measurement Chamber Focus: Deep involvement in evaluating electro\-mechanical hardware (currents, voltages, clamping forces) and configuring lab instrumentation like encoders and oscilloscopes. You will act as the primary point of contact for unit defects in Operations or the BSL\-2 lab.  
Fluidics Component Focus: Centers around fundamental fluid mechanics, requiring expertise with fluidic components (valves, connectors) and measurement equipment. You will heavily execute tightness, stress, and endurance testing on fluidic consumables.  
Oximetry Focus: Demands physical testing on precision hardware, specifically mechanical oscillators and optics. You will evaluate microfluidic chips and perform biological sample preparation (such as handling whole blood and adjusting hematocrit levels) safely inside a BSL\-2 laboratory.  
HW Unit \& Subsystem Testing Focus: Revolves around the ownership of Unit Specifications (USP) and extensive Configuration \& Item Management (tracking CIs and revision statuses). You will serve as the technical bridge during the integration phase, managing hardware\-software dependencies.  
Must Haves (across all four profiles):  
A degree (BSc, MSc, PhD, or equivalent HF Apprenticeship) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline  
Between 3 to 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in hardware testing, mechatronic unit verification, or product development  
Proven expertise working in a highly regulated medical device, In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD), or life sciences environment (FDA/MDR)  
Strong hands\-on experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) systems (such as Codebeamer or PLM) for requirement traceability, and agile tools like Jira  
Professional proficiency in English is a strict requirement as it is the project language. Fluency or a strong understanding of German is a distinct advantage or required for daily operations, depending on the focus  
What you will be offered:  
An opportunity to work in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical companies  
Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas  
Central location in Rotkreuz not far from the train station  
Varied job profile  
Further training opportunities through temptraining

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
For people who figure things out, stay curious, and build things that actually work.

At ekona, we build production-grade AI systems for clients in multiple industries including life sciences and supply chain, where quality is not optional. They trust us because we think independently, move fast, and deliver with Swiss reliability.

We're looking for engineers who do not wait for perfect instructions. Who explore, experiment, break problems down, and build solutions that matter. Who enjoy ambiguity because it gives them room to think. Who can sit with a client, understand their pain, and fix it with the right mix of engineering and AI.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

What You'll Do
Real engineering. Real users. Real impact.

Understand problems deeply
Engage directly with clients and their domain experts. Ask the right questions, map the problem, challenge assumptions.

Build fast, build well
Prototype quickly, then turn prototypes into robust, production-ready systems. Design and deploy multi-agent workflows and LLM-powered applications. Combine modern software engineering with state-of-the-art AI tooling.

Ship end-to-end
Own your work from architecture through testing, deployment, observability, and iteration in cloud environments, with modern engineering practices.

Shape how we work
Influence our technical roadmap. Help develop our AI engineering playbook, frameworks, and internal tooling. Your ideas will be heard.

What We're Looking For
The exact stack matters less than how you think, learn, and build. That said, you'll likely be a fit if you have:

Several years of professional software engineering experience, shipping systems to real users
Comfort with cloud-native development: containers, CI/CD, at least one major cloud platform
Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agent frameworks, or a clear track record of picking up new technical domains fast
The ability to talk to non-technical stakeholders and translate their problems into working software
A strong bias toward shipping
Nice to have: domain experience in life sciences, pharma, supply chain, or finance; knowledge graphs, RAG systems, or LLM observability.

Why ekona
Engineering quality actually matters. Our clients feel the difference, and so will you.
Real projects, regulated industries. The work has weight.
Founding-team environment. Autonomy, trust, and direct influence on where we go next.
No AI theater. No bureaucracy, no endless meetings, no demos dressed up as deliverables.
Entrepreneurial culture. Fast-moving, pragmatic, grown-up.
Is This You?
If you're happiest planning, specifying, and polishing without ever putting something in front of a user, this probably isn't the right place.

If you want to ship impactful AI products alongside a small team that holds itself to a high bar, it probably is.

Interested?
Reach out. Let's talk.
